meta.what: Skeptic re-read of the o1 measurer (o1_labels.json / o1_measured.json): every guarded block, every wrong/multi/unclear block, 12 seeded-random single_right blocks, and in fact every one of the 168 matched blocks; labels in o1_skeptic_labels.json written before this driver ran; the unit-7 rule re-run unchanged.
notes: No class changed. 159 single_right, 9 wrong_other, 0 multi_lot_contract, 0 unclear. The rule re-run reproduces the measurer exactly: G4 on 17 blocks (9 wrong + 8 right), G3 on 10 (7 wrong + 3 right), G5 0, G6 0. The served set equals the replay set, and every served lot equals the replay lot.

8286472 / CAN 16994904 is confirmed as a contract counter. LOT_NUMBER = CONTRACT_NO 01..17. Lots 9 (423,000) and 19 (366,642.54) are missing from the CAN value list. The value cross-check finds that RES-9..17 each have the estimate of LOT-(k+1) exactly. G4 (notice) catches 9/9. The 8 refused right blocks are the known G4 cost (unit-7 risk 3, the 5051007 shape). Outside this notice there are 0 of 151 false refusals.

G3 false positive confirmed: lot_designators.designators() reads "(pakiet 8 pozycji) ... - zadanie 4" as [8, 4]. The count phrase "pakiet N pozycji/pozycje" (a package of N items) counts as a designator, so G3 alone refuses 3 of 159 right blocks (RES-4, 5, 8). G4 masks this here. In a notice not numbered by a counter, it would be a real G3 false refusal whenever N is a number one of the inherited lots prints and differs from k. Without G4, G3 catches only 7 of the 9 wrong blocks: RES-9 "pakiet 36" (36 not in N) and RES-16 "pakiet 17 / zadanie 17" leave |Dn| = 1.

8338322 is no longer label-by-numbering-only. The CN III.2.3 prints a per-task experience threshold "dla zadania nr k". Each block's estimate / 2 (24-month contract) sits just above the threshold for its printed k, on all 13 blocks. That includes 18 vs 19, whose descriptions are identical.

The measurer wrote 5084145's ratios as 4.5x..197x; they actually run 4.5x..763x (RES-8, Вариант 12). The titles name exactly one lot each and no lot permutation fits the values, so these are value anomalies. 5179195 CAN estimates are 1/4 of the CN lot values (the CN's 480,000 for lot 3 is a typo for 48,000). 5251601 RES-19's estimate is copied from LOT-22 / RES-20, while its title and award fit LOT-21.
Cache spot-check: live GET /v1/tenders/8286472 and /v1/notices/16994904/content (2 GETs, both 200) equal cache_o1 as parsed JSON (lot_results, versions, full notice content).
